<b>{{PAGENAME}}s</b> are a relatively generic quest item, used in a variety of applications, usually quest-related. The [[Inquisitor]] asks the player to provide 10x for a [[quest]]. They are also used for [[marketing campaign]]s and [[Talking Skull#Tavern Events|tavern events]]. Creating them requires the Business of Faith Technology from the [[Theology (Tech Tree)|Theology]] tree.

==Tips & Tricks==
Regarding the mass-production of <b>{{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}s</b>, despite crafting them at a desk requiring [[feather]]s, and significantly more energy and time, the [[printing press]] is incredibly inefficient when it comes to [[ink]]. For every 10x {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}s crafted, utilizing pen-and-inks will consume 1/3 of the ink that a printing press will, if not less (one may use <50% pen-and-inks). Thus, if one has a severe shortage of [[black paint]], avoid using the printing press, despite it being more efficient overall.
